0022600001.text: The Detroit Pistons open their 2026-27 season at home against the Boston Celtics, who are also opening their season. Taurean Prince is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision for Detroit, while Devin Carter is out with an illness for Boston. The Pistons won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat the Celtics 104-103 in Detroit on January 19, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Detroit a 50% chance to win.
